channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 7A
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 7A (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 7A: The City's Legistar pages list the amended…
item.description: The City's Legistar pages list the amended development agreement (File 260724) and its zoning ordinance (File 260770) as approved by the Mayor and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Enactment Nos. 208-26 and 209-26). The summary and the September 29 timeline entry still said enactment was not confirmed or still to come; the source entry for File 260724 is now dated October 13, 2026. Both ordinances say 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a) and File 260724, in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment), which makes November 13, 2026 the effective date by our count, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text; the heights and uses in the enacted text are not yet checked against this record. The record's timeline now has an entry for the Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), before the Mayor's approval. Source: SF Board of Supervisors, Legistar, BOS File 260724 and File 260770 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745); Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachments: https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063745&GUID=68B0CE5F-84C2-4368-BF8D-EEA7D8B92E55 and https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063746&GUID=9EA91A49-BBF9-4471-9EA9-6E7BD33A4353.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 7A: SF Planning's Block 7A hearing materials name the…
item.description: SF Planning's Block 7A hearing materials name the building on this part of Block 7 'Block 7A', beside the affordable Block 7B, which this dataset maps as the Sophie Maxwell Building. 'Remaining portion' says only that this shape is what is left of Block 7 once that building is taken out; the record's text keeps saying so. That this lot is Block 7A is Pier & Point's reading from location, shape and size, as the record's accuracy note states. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: SF Planning Commission, Potrero Power Station Block 7A informational hearing, July 15, 2021 (https://commissions.sfplanning.org/cpcpackets/10.%20Potrero%20Power%20Station%20Block%207A.pdf), PDF page 14, slide titled "Block 7a Planning Commission Informational", in the packet for the Planning Commission hearing of July 15, 2021 (an event date).

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 7A: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026…
item.description: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026 sets new height limits for Block 7: 248 ft over a 93 ft base. They take effect 31 days after enactment, November 13, 2026 by our count; until then the earlier limits (240 ft) apply. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 7A: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated… (Oct 13, 2026)
item.description: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated Development Agreement (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): Legistar lists both as 'Status: Passed' with 'Final action: 10/13/2026', 'Enactment date: 10/13/2026' and enactment numbers 208-26 (File 260724) and 209-26 (File 260770), and a history row '10/13/2026 ... Mayor ... APPROVED' for each. The Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes) is the previous entry on this timeline. October 13, 2026 is the enactment date, from the Clerk of the Board's listing (page read October 14 and again October 17, 2026); it is an event date. Both ordinances provide 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a), p. 56 of its 'Leg Final' attachment; File 260724, p. 10 of its attachment); counted from October 13, 2026 that is November 13, 2026, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text. (Oct 13, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 7A: Board of Supervisors finally passes the… (Oct 6, 2026)
item.description: Board of Supervisors finally passes the Amended and Restated Development Agreement ordinance (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): the Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachment to each file lists 'October 06, 2026 Board of Supervisors - FINALLY PASSED', 'Ayes: 11 - Chan, Chen, Dorsey, Fielder, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter, Sherrill, Walton and Wong' (File 260724 attachment pp. 11-12; File 260770 attachment pp. 58-59), and the Clerk's certificate says each ordinance 'was FINALLY PASSED on 10/6/2026 by the Board of Supervisors'. item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 7A: Block 7's heights now follow the Design for…
item.description: Block 7's heights now follow the Design for Development's colour-coded labels: a 240 ft maximum with an 85 ft base in the north-west part and 85 ft elsewhere (the earlier '150 ft base' was a plan dimension). The unit list no longer includes 315, which is Block 8's figure on the Planning Commission slides, and the 27-story and 325-unit figures are attributed to SF YIMBY rather than the slides. The design review application date now follows Planning's memo (December 19, 2020). The expected completion moved from 2028 (a press figure) to 2029, the end of Phase 1's schedule in the October 2020 approval, and is marked soft because earlier 2020 forecasts did not hold. 'Market-rate rental' now says the developer anticipates rental units. The Foster + Partners rendering was removed because the plan sheets are marked as copyrighted by the architect; the design review packet remains cited. The dead 2019 draft link was replaced with the final February 2020 document and the Fifth Space rename no longer carries a year. Source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning Commission, Block 7A informational hearing slides, 2021-07-15 (https://commissions.sfplanning.org/cpcpackets/10.%20Potrero%20Power%20Station%20Block%207A.pdf); SF YIMBY, 2021-07-14 (https://sfyimby.com/2021/07/new-details-for-foster-partners-designed-potrero-power-station-block-7a-san-francisco.html); SF Planning, Block 7A Design Review Approval, 2022-03-02 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station).
